content.title: Route to Homes results without dates and add dates from the results page
content.intent: Prove the partial-input flow routes with destination and guests only, preserves those inputs, and allows dates to be added later on the results page.
content.technique_notes: Techniques: state_flow for homepage-to-results navigation; eqp for the explicit no-dates path and typed destination classes. Risk-judged interaction strength = 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss promise applies. The omitted-dates path is a source-defined supported variation, so it is modeled as its own scenario rather than a negative case.
